summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of 'You're Not Down' Nashville discovery app. 29/29 backend pytest tests pass after fixing one storage init bug. Full frontend flow validated: homepage CTA -> categories grid (all 9 pills) -> category detail with Call/Directions/Website buttons (4 cards on /c/food, 8 cards on /c/surprise-me). /admin without auth redirects to /admin/login (Google sign-in CTA present). With injected admin session cookie, /admin loads dashboard listing all 30 seeded businesses, and Analytics tab shows numeric counters (homepage_visit=18, im_down_click=7, category_click=8, business_view=54, phone/directions/website_click=2 each) along with by-category and by-business breakdowns.
action_items: No outstanding issues. The storage_client EMERGENT_LLM_KEY-read-at-import bug was fixed during testing (now read lazily inside init_storage so load_dotenv timing in server.py no longer matters).
critical_code_review_comments: storage_client.py originally captured EMERGENT_LLM_KEY at module import time, but in server.py the import of storage_client happens BEFORE load_dotenv() runs, so the key was always None and every /api/admin/upload returned 500. Fixed by reading the env var lazily inside init_storage().

ADMIN_EMAILS bootstrap behavior (empty allowlist -> first signed-in user becomes admin) is convenient for first-run, but should be tightened with a real allowlist before production. Currently any random Google account that arrives first via OAuth gets full admin.
/api/auth/session sets cookie with samesite=none + secure=true which is correct for cross-origin; verified working through Bearer header path too. No issue, just a note.
Backend uses startup events (deprecated in newer FastAPI in favor of lifespan) — works but consider migrating.

CategoryDetailPage fires trackEvent('business_view', ...) inside a forEach right after fetch — this generates one analytics POST per card on every render of the page (no de-dupe). Could inflate analytics; consider client-side throttling or server-side de-dupe per (session, business_id, day).

seed_data_creation: Backend startup auto-seeds 9 categories, 1 city (Nashville), and 30 businesses on empty DB. Tests created/deleted a TEST_Biz row and cleaned up. Admin/user session docs were injected via mongosh and left in place for follow-up testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin token in /app/memory/test_credentials.md works via Authorization: Bearer header OR session_token cookie. Public URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL = https://whatsyoudown.preview.emergentagent.com. All 29 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass. Frontend flow: / -> [data-testid=homepage-im-down-button] -> /categories ([data-testid=category-btn-<slug>]) -> /c/<slug> (cards with [data-testid=business-call-<id>], business-directions-<id>, business-website-<id>). Admin dashboard testids: admin-dashboard, admin-tab-businesses, admin-tab-analytics, admin-analytics, admin-user-email, admin-logout-button.
rca of the issue: Bug found and fixed during testing: POST /api/admin/upload returned 500 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not set'. RCA: storage_client.py read os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY') at module-import time. server.py imports storage_client BEFORE calling load_dotenv(), so the env var read happened before the .env file was loaded into os.environ, capturing None permanently. Mitigation: moved the env read inside init_storage() so it is evaluated lazily on first use, after load_dotenv has run. Verified by re-running TestAdminUpload — upload + GET /api/files/{path} both return 200.
